company.name: ExoSat
company.shortDescription: ExoSat provides propulsion as a service for satellites using space debris as in-orbit propulsive resource.
company.description: ExoSat develops propulsion as a service solutions for satellites using in-orbit debris as a propulsive resource. The company uses laser ablation and vision-guided navigation to intercept and process orbital debris into usable thrust for satellite maneuvers. Its services support autonomous in-orbit maneuvering and adaptive docking with cooperative and non-cooperative spacecraft. ExoSat focuses on NewSpace operators that require flexible, reusable orbital mobility without relying solely on onboard propellant. By linking debris removal with propulsion supply, its model aligns satellite operations with cleaner near-Earth orbital environments. The company targets satellite operators and in-space service providers that need station-keeping, repositioning, and life-extension capabilities.

productsAndServices.description: An in-space propulsion service that uses orbital debris as propulsive power for satellite mobility.
